title: Essence Ascendance - wineglass cast
description: A new cast direction: one light fork-tine tap on the bowl of a wineglass. A tiny contact and a clear tapering glass ring. The approved sounds are unchanged; this new candidate awaits review.

listening.title: Eight taps at 400 ms intervals
listening.description: Complete glass tails overlap at their original levels. A listening demonstration, not an in-game test.
